modern: Does another do me wrong? Let him see to it. He has his own disposition, his own activity. I now have what the universal nature now wills me to have; and I do what my nature now wills me to do.

explained.summary: If someone wrongs me, that’s their business: their character and their actions belong to them. My business is to accept what the universe has given me right now and do what my own nature asks of me right now. Marcus keeps the two firmly separate.
explained.today: When a friend lets you down or someone is rude to you at the till, their behaviour is theirs to answer for. Yours is how you respond and what you do next with your afternoon.
